extracted.intended_audience: Authors and teams preparing Cochrane systematic reviews of interventions; systematic reviewers, meta-analysts, guideline developers, and evidence synthesis researchers
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance for planning, conducting, reporting, updating, and interpreting systematic reviews of interventions (Cochrane Reviews), covering core methods (searching, selection, risk of bias, synthesis, GRADE) and topic-specific considerations (equity, harms, economics, qualitative evidence, etc.).

rubrics_metrics.name: About Cochrane Reviews
rubrics_metrics.description: Overview material about the nature, purpose and structure of Cochrane Reviews.

rubrics_metrics.name: I: Introduction
rubrics_metrics.description: Introductory material for the Handbook and Cochrane Reviews.

rubrics_metrics.name: II: Planning a Cochrane Review
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance on planning the review process and protocol development.

rubrics_metrics.name: III: Reporting the review
rubrics_metrics.description: Standards and guidance for reporting Cochrane Reviews.

rubrics_metrics.name: III.S1: Supplementary material: Considerations and recommendations for figures in Cochrane reviews: graphs of statistical data
rubrics_metrics.description: Supplementary guidance on preparing and presenting graphical displays of statistical data in reviews.

rubrics_metrics.name: III.S2: Supplementary material: Guidance for writing a Cochrane Plain language summary
rubrics_metrics.description: Supplementary guidance on producing plain language summaries for Cochrane Reviews.

rubrics_metrics.name: IV: Updating a review
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance on when and how to update a systematic review.

rubrics_metrics.name: V: Overviews of Reviews
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance on producing overviews (reviews of systematic reviews).

rubrics_metrics.name: Chapter 1: Starting a review
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance on initial steps and considerations when initiating a systematic review.

rubrics_metrics.name: Chapter 2: Determining the scope of the review and the questions it will address
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance on defining the review scope and formulating research questions (e.g., PICO-type framing).

rubrics_metrics.name: Chapter 3: Defining the criteria for including studies and how they will be grouped for the synthesis
rubrics_metrics.description: Standards for eligibility criteria and approaches to grouping studies for synthesis.

rubrics_metrics.name: Chapter 4: Searching for and selecting studies
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance on comprehensive literature searching and study selection processes.

rubrics_metrics.name: 4.S1: Supplementary material: Technical supplement
rubrics_metrics.description: Technical supplementary resources related to searching and selection (linked to Chapter 4).

rubrics_metrics.name: 4.S2: Supplementary material: Appendix of resources
rubrics_metrics.description: Appendix of resources to support searching and study selection.

rubrics_metrics.name: Chapter 5: Collecting data
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance on data extraction and management from included studies.

rubrics_metrics.name: Chapter 6: Choosing effect measures and computing estimates of effect
rubrics_metrics.description: Standards for selecting effect measures and calculating effect estimates.

rubrics_metrics.name: Chapter 7: Considering bias and conflicts of interest among the included studies
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance on identifying and considering study-level bias and conflicts of interest.

rubrics_metrics.name: Chapter 8: Assessing risk of bias in a randomized trial
rubrics_metrics.description: Methods and criteria for assessing risk of bias in randomized trials.

rubrics_metrics.name: Chapter 9: Summarizing study characteristics and preparing for synthesis
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance on tabulating study characteristics and preparing data for synthesis.

rubrics_metrics.name: Chapter 10: Analysing data and undertaking meta-analyses
rubrics_metrics.description: Standards and methods for analysis and meta-analysis of study data.

rubrics_metrics.name: Chapter 11: Undertaking network meta-analyses
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance on methods for network (multiple treatments) meta-analysis.

rubrics_metrics.name: Chapter 12: Synthesizing and presenting findings using other methods
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance on non-meta-analytic synthesis methods and presentation of findings.

rubrics_metrics.name: Chapter 13: Assessing risk of bias due to missing results in a synthesis
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance on detecting and assessing bias from missing results (publication/availability bias) in syntheses.

rubrics_metrics.name: Chapter 14: Completing ‘Summary of findings’ tables and grading the certainty of the evidence
rubrics_metrics.description: Standards for producing summary of findings tables and applying GRADE to rate certainty of evidence.

rubrics_metrics.name: Chapter 15: Interpreting results and drawing conclusions
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance on interpretation of synthesized results and formulation of review conclusions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Chapter 16: Equity and specific populations
rubrics_metrics.description: Considerations for equity and analysis of effects in specific populations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Chapter 17: Intervention complexity
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance on addressing and synthesizing complex interventions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Chapter 18: Patient-reported outcomes
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance on handling and reporting patient-reported outcome measures.

rubrics_metrics.name: Chapter 19: Adverse effects
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance on identifying, collecting, and synthesizing evidence about harms/adverse effects.

rubrics_metrics.name: Chapter 20: Economic evidence
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance on identifying and synthesizing economic evidence related to interventions.

rubrics_metrics.name: 20.S: Technical Supplement: Integrated full systematic review of economic evidence
rubrics_metrics.description: Technical supplement providing detailed methods for full systematic reviews of economic evidence.

rubrics_metrics.name: Chapter 21: Qualitative evidence
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance on locating, appraising, and synthesizing qualitative evidence relevant to interventions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Chapter 22: Prospective approaches to accumulating evidence
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance on prospective methods for accumulating and updating evidence (e.g., prospective meta-analysis, living reviews).

rubrics_metrics.name: Chapter 23: Including variants on randomized trials
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance on including and handling variants of randomized trial designs in reviews.

rubrics_metrics.name: Chapter 24: Including non-randomized studies on intervention effects
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance on when and how to include non-randomized studies of intervention effects.

rubrics_metrics.name: Chapter 25: Assessing risk of bias in a non-randomized study
rubrics_metrics.description: Methods and criteria for assessing risk of bias in non-randomized studies.

rubrics_metrics.name: Chapter 26: Individual participant data
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance on use, collection, and synthesis of individual participant data (IPD) in reviews.
